chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'The most beloved of deeds to God, Mighty and Majestic, on the earth is supplication, and the most superior of worship is chastity.'
He said: 'And Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was a man who frequently supplicated.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Believers — the title of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS)
key_terms.الدُّعَاءُ: Supplication (du'a) — direct personal prayer and invocation to God, distinct from ritual salat
key_terms.الْعَفَافُ: Chastity or abstinence ('afaf) — restraint from unlawful desires, a comprehensive virtue
key_terms.الْعِبَادَةِ: Worship ('ibadah) — all acts of devotion and obedience to God
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic — an honorific epithet for God

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say is the most beloved deed to God on earth?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a statement of Imam Ali (AS) ranking supplication as the most beloved earthly deed to God, and chastity as the highest form of worship. This hadith is found in Al-Kafi's chapter on the merits of supplication, emphasizing that du'a — direct communication with God — surpasses all other acts in divine favor. The additional observation that Imam Ali himself was a frequent supplicant reinforces the teaching by example, linking the doctrinal statement to the Imam's personal practice.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The most Beloved of the deeds to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic in the earth, is the supplication, and the most superior of the (acts of) worship is the chastity’.
Heasws said: ‘And Amir Al-Momineenasws was a (frequently) supplicating person’.
en.sarwar: 8. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Ash’ari from ibn al-Qaddah from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) has said, ‘The most beloved of deeds before Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, on earth is pleading before Him for help and the best worship is chastity.’
The Imam said, ‘Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) was a very prayerful man.’”
